sources: Sources: IMF World Economic Outlook, October 2026 (PPPPC, NGDPDPC, NGDP_RPCH, PCPIPCH, GGXWDG_NGDP, LUR, LP). "Passed" = GDP per capita in PPP below Argentina's in 2000 and above it every year from the crossing through 2026.

clips.title: Argentina was richer than South Korea and Poland in 1990 #Shorts
clips.desc: GDP per person, PPP (IMF WEO Oct 2026): 1990 Argentina $8.3k > Korea $7.7k, Poland $6.7k, Chile $5.9k. 2026: Korea $70k, Poland $60k, Chile $37k, Argentina $33k.

clips.title: 22 countries passed Argentina since 2000 #Shorts
clips.desc: Countries poorer than Argentina per person in 2000 that are richer today (IMF, GDP per capita PPP, Oct 2026).
